title: Printable probability scale
subject: Mathematics
unit: Summer 2: Number sense; sets and probability; primes and proof
source: Seeded from mathematics/y7 lesson 78 (Printable probability scale)
intro: Lesson 78: The probability scale. To understand how to describe and compare how likely events are using the probability scale from 0 to 1

questions.q: Place 'roll a 1 or 2 on a dice' on the scale.
questions.model: 2 of the 6 equally likely outcomes. 2/6 = 1/3, between 0 and 1/2: unlikely.

questions.q: Write 0.25 as a fraction and a percentage.
Is 'a baby is born on a Sunday' likely?
Mark on a 0 to 1 scale: (a) spin red on a spinner with 3 red and 1 blue equal sections (b) roll a prime on a dice (c) pick a vowel from the letters of MATHS
questions.model: (b) Primes on a dice: 2, 3, 5: 3 out of 6. 3/6 = 1/2: even chance.

questions.q: Describe an event with probability exactly 0.2 using a bag of counters.
questions.a: For example 1 red and 4 blue counters: P(red) = 1/5 = 0.2

questions.q: Big question: can we be certain?
questions.a: Some events are certain or impossible in maths; most are somewhere in between. Only Allah knows the unseen.
